$source: SAHA Residences website redesign, 2026-10-18. Addition to the brand guide v1.0 tokens (which define no motion). Implemented in src/styles/motion.css. See docs/redesign/report.md for every animation that uses them.

micro.use: Hover, focus, press, colour changes. Range 150 to 250ms.

state.use: State changes: price updates, calendar month, tabs, room selection, page transitions.

reveal.use: Entrances of text and photos when time-based. Range 600 to 900ms.

draw.use: Time-based line drawings (decorative strokes). Scroll-linked drawings follow the scroll instead.

settle.use: Default. Calm deceleration for anything arriving or revealing.

glide.use: Movement between two states, such as page transitions.

stagger.use: Delay between items in a sequence (scroll ranges use about 4% per item).

distance.use: The furthest anything travels on entrance.

rules: Animate transform, opacity, clip-path and stroke-dashoffset only. Never animate layout.
The hero headline and hero photo are never animated in. The LCP element is visible on first paint.
Every animated element is fully visible without CSS support, without JavaScript and with prefers-reduced-motion.
Scroll-linked, never scroll-jacked. Nothing loops. Off-screen animations do nothing.
No animation delays booking: new values appear at once and settle in.
